title: Collagen Coating for Tissue Culture
protocol: Dilute PureCol® collagen to 50 µg/mL in cell culture grade water.
Keep the diluted collagen on ice.
Swirl contents gently until material is completely mixed.
Add 7 mL of the mixture to a 100mm tissue culture dish.
Ensure the entire surface of the tissue culture dish is coated.
Incubate the dish lid-covered plate at room temperature for 2 hours.
Rinse coated surfaces with sterile PBS using the specified volumes.
For tissue culture dishes, use 7 mL per 100mm dish and 15 mL per 150mm dish.
For 6 well plates, rinse with 1.0 mL per 24mm insert and 1.5 mL per well.
For 12 well plates, rinse with 250 µL per 12mm insert and 750 µL per well.
Aspirate the wash carefully to ensure as much of it is removed as possible.
Allow residual wash to pool by tilting the plates for easier aspiration.
Air dry dishes and plates in a biosafety cabinet with lids cracked slightly open.
Label dishes and plates with the date using a green permanent marker.
Repackage dishes and plates into their original bags.
Store repackaged dishes and plates in plastic bins at 4°C.
